# awx_user_associate_role (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "awx_user_associate_role" "user_team_admin" {
  user_id = awx_user.user_role.id
  role_id = data.awx_team_object_roles.team_role.roles["Admin"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `role_id` (Number) Database ID of the role to assign.
- `user_id` (Number) Database ID for this User.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
# The import ID is <user_id>/<role_id>
import {
  to = awx_user_associate_role.example
  id = "1/2"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The import ID is <user_id>/<role_id>
terraform import awx_user_associate_role.example 1/2
```
